_comment: cúramóir hooks. Verified against the live hooks reference 2026-10-06.
Re-verify before editing: event names and response schemas change between releases.
PreToolUse (E0-R5): the destructive-command denylist. Scoped to Bash by
`matcher`, with a short explicit timeout — the default is 600s and a timed-out
command hook fails OPEN, so an unbounded timeout would stall every Bash call
for ten minutes while protecting nothing.
The handoff hooks (Epic 8) use THREE events, not the two the spec names,
because Stop does not mean what the spec assumes:
Stop        fires at the end of EVERY TURN. One cheap journal append, no
model call, 3s timeout. Writing a full handoff here would mean
dozens of writes and model calls per session.
PreCompact  fires before context is discarded, which is when a handoff is
most needed. Writes the full handoff. Never blocks compaction.
SessionEnd  finalises on exit. SessionEnd hooks SHARE a 1.5s budget, so this
is deterministic only and declares a 2s ceiling to stay inside it.
Guards promoted from rules (E4-R4b) will register separately with matcher
